title: Daily Gospel
text: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene. When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son! Then saith he to the disciple, Behold thy mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home.
text_source_note: Complete Gospel displayed in the public-domain King James Version. Vatican News is the liturgical source for the day's Gospel reference.
